wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 09-002 aggregates the player-movement functions (thrust, calcHeight, movePlayer) and ticcmd button-decode helpers (applyUseButtonLatch, decodeWeaponChangeRequest) plus the BT_/BTS_ flag constants into a single src/vanilla re-export facade for P_PlayerThink. The read-only src/player/movement.ts and implement-ticcmd-application.ts already implement vanilla p_user.c / g_game.c semantics; pure barrel + frozen manifest, no source modification.
